items.h: Seth McGowan gets four touches, leaves with injury Thursday night
items.s: Seth McGowan gained seven yards on three carries and just one yard on one catch before exiting Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans with a hamstring injury. McGowan had been a bright spot for the struggling Colts in recent weeks, as the rookie back has looked like a capable ball carrier behind veteran Jonathan Taylor. Unfortunately, he sustained a hamstring injury after just a few touches Thursday night and did not return to the contest. McGowan has averaged an impressive 5.0 yards on his 58 total carries with two touchdowns so far this season. He's got plenty of fantasy value sharing the backfield with Taylor as long as the injury doesn't force him to miss time.

items.h: Won't return to Thursday Night Football
items.s: McGowan (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Thursday's game against the Texans, Jane Slater of NFL Network reports. McGowan was injured just before halftime while returning a kickoff. He was deemed questionable to return at the beginning of the third quarter and subsequently was ruled out shortly thereafter. The rookie running back gained seven yards on three carries and caught his only target for one yard before exiting while adding 117 yards on three kickoff returns. Jonathan Taylor should continue to get most of the work at running back for the Colts for the rest of the game, and DJ Giddens should handle whatever backfield snaps that Taylor doesn't get.

items.h: Questionable to return to TNF
items.s: McGowan is dealing with a hamstring injury and is questionable to return to Thursday's Week 11 game against Houston. McGowan appeared to get injured while returning a kickoff just before halftime. The rookie running back had three carries for seven yards and one catch for one yard before getting hurt. Should McGowan not be able to return to action Thursday, Jonathan Taylor would likely get an even bigger share of carries for the Colts, and DJ Giddens should get more opportunities as well.

items.h: Seth McGowan Ruled Out for Remainder of Thursday's Game
items.s: The Indianapolis Colts ruled out running back Seth McGowan (hamstring) for the rest of the Thursday night game against the division-rival Houston Texans after he injured his hamstring towards the end of the first half on a kickoff, according to Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Sports. It ends a disappointing night for the 25-year-old rookie after his career-best performance in the Week 10 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday, when he had 12 carries for 77 yards and his second touchdown in as many weeks. Before leaving on Thursday in Houston, McGowan had only three carries for seven yards and one catch for a gain of one yard. Jonathan Taylor will now see more backfield touches for the Colts for the…

items.h: Seth McGowan Worth Considering in All Leagues
items.s: Indianapolis running back Seth McGowan has scored touchdowns in back-to-back games and has carved out a big enough offensive role to consider possibly starting him in all fantasy football leagues for Week 11. His matchup against the Texans on Thursday night is pretty average. The teams met back in Week 3, when McGowan wasn't nearly as big an offensive threat for Indianapolis. Along with a score in two straight games, McGowan has 122 rushing yards over 18 attempts. He has five or more rushing attempts in four straight games now, and with more production of late, he's a rising fantasy asset. McGowan is RB34 in our RotoBaller Week 11 projections, putting him outside most standard leagues, but…

items.h: Seth McGowan punches in score in win over Dolphins
items.s: Seth McGowan ran for 77 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. McGowan wasn't involved in the passing game, but when you can run for 6.4 yards a pop and find the end zone, that makes up for a lot. He is becoming more involved in the offense in recent weeks and could be finding his way into flex territory. Granted, touchdowns have greatly helped his fantasy production, without them he would be much less appealing.

items.h: Seth McGowan Is a Week 11 Bench Stash
items.s: Indianapolis Colts running back Seth McGowan carried the ball on 12 of his 17 offensive snaps against the Miami Dolphins on Sunday. He finished with 77 yards and a touchdown after rushing for 45 yards and a score on six carries against the Dallas Cowboys. His snap share slipped from 31% to 29% across those games. Before Sunday, he'd reached double-digit carries just once, with 11 against the Minnesota Vikings in Week 7. Both touchdowns came from inside the five-yard line, giving McGowan some flex appeal in 14-team half-PPR leagues on Thursday at Houston. McGowan has five catches for nine yards all season, and Jonathan Taylor drew all four backfield targets against Miami. Taylor also led…

items.h: Retains expanded role Sunday
items.s: McGowan rushed 12 times for 77 yards and a touchdown and returned two kickoffs for 61 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. The rookie had shown well in recent weeks while trade speculation swirled around Jonathan Taylor, and even though the latter ultimately stayed put at the deadline, McGowan still compiled a new career high in rush attempts and rushing yards. The Kentucky product also followed up his first career rushing touchdown in Week 9 against the Cowboys with a four-yard scoring run early in the second quarter Sunday, and McGowan was also productive in his returner role. While Taylor should remain the de facto top backfield option for the Colts, McGowan should…

items.h: Seth McGowan Scores Again on Career-High 12 Carries
items.s: Indianapolis Colts running back Seth McGowan picked up the final first down of Sunday's 24-22 win over the Miami Dolphins with consecutive runs of eight and four yards, allowing Indianapolis to kneel out the clock. He finished with a career-high 12 carries for 77 yards and a touchdown. McGowan gained eight yards on the final play of the first quarter and scored from four yards out on the next snap. He later broke a 23-yard run to Miami's one-yard line. Jonathan Taylor took the next handoff and lost a yard. McGowan had eight carries by halftime to Taylor's nine. Taylor finished with 83 yards on 16 carries and caught two of four targets for 20 yards. McGowan went without a target. McGowan…

items.h: Live on CBS: Seth McGowan puts the Colts on the board
Seth McGowan a Deep-League Option in Week 10 in Reserve Role
items.s: Indianapolis running back Seth McGowan is just a deep-league fantasy option due to Jonathan Taylor remaining with the team after the trade deadline. McGowan has carved out a decent offensive role though, carrying the ball 43 times for 208 yards and a touchdown so far, while also hauling in five of his six targets for nine yards. He has played 22.3% of the team's offensive snaps so far. Miami is a pretty favorable matchup for running backs, so McGowan has a little fantasy appeal, but just in deeper leagues. He's RB46 in our RotoBaller Week 10 projections, showing he's only startable in deeper setups. McGowan would only become a standard league option if Taylor were injured, so that's…

items.h: Seth McGowan's Fantasy Value Hinges on Potential Trade
items.s: Indianapolis Colts rookie running back Seth McGowan had six carries for 45 yards and a touchdown, along with one reception for minus-three yards in the 27-23 loss to the Dallas Cowboys. As McGowan continues to carve out a role behind starting Jonathan Taylor, the rookie scored his first career touchdown from two yards out. Taylor has been involved in trade talks, and he said postgame, "I just hope that they appreciate and know that I appreciate them and it was a pleasure to put on display not only my hard work but the team's hard work each and every single week, each and every single year. Just know it was a pleasure." If Taylor is dealt prior to Tuesday's deadline, McGowan should factor…

items.h: Judging overreactions to NFL Week 9 -- and what they mean for the trade deadline
items.s: Is it time for the Bengals to make a push? Should the Giants aggressively go after a running back? Will the receiver market go wild? We're overreacting to Sunday's games.

items.h: Gets into end zone in loss
items.s: McGowan rushed six times for 45 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for minus-3 yards in the Colts' 27-23 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. McGowan recorded his first NFL touchdown on a two-yard run in the first quarter, perhaps a harbinger of a larger role as early as next Sunday's Week 10 matchup against the Dolphins. McGowan came just a rush yard short of equaling his career-best tally in that category, and if Jonathan Taylor is indeed moved off the roster by Tuesday's trade deadline, the former would be in line to serve as the lead back moving forward.

items.h: Seth McGowan finds the end zone in Week 9
items.s: Seth McGowan carried the ball six times for 45 yards and a touchdown while losing three yards on his lone reception in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9. McGowan punched in a two-yard touchdown in the first quarter to give the Colts their first points of the game. The rookie running back could be the team's starting running back in Week 10 against the Dolphins if the Colts wind up trading Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's trade deadline. McGowan would be a locked-in RB2 in fantasy for Week 10 if that were to happen.

items.h: Seth McGowan scores his first NFL TD
Seth McGowan is Too Risky To Start
items.s: Indianapolis Colts running back Seth McGowan remains a top stash target ahead of the trade deadline. It sounds likely that the Colts will keep Jonathan Taylor, but fantasy managers should stash McGowan just in case. Last week, McGowan carried the ball five times for 29 yards during the blowout loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars. With Taylor possibly leaving, McGowan could see an expanded role during the Week 9 matchup against the Dallas Cowboys. It's a favorable matchup with the Cowboys having the worst run defense in the league. Despite it being a great matchup, McGowan is too risky to start in fantasy formats with Taylor still on the team. The 25-year-old is worth stashing, but he isn't an…

items.h: Breaks one long run Week 8
items.s: McGowan rushed five times for 29 yards and returned four kickoffs for 103 yards Sunday in a loss to the Jaguars. McGowan's best run was a 16-yarder up the middle midway through the third quarter to take the ball to Jacksonville's three-yard line. That set up Indianapolis' only touchdown in the blowout loss. McGowan logged a modest 15 offensive snaps to starter Jonathan Taylor's 38, but the former outgained Taylor on the ground, 29-23. Meanwhile, DJ Giddens paced the Colts with 43 rushing yards on six totes. The big story, of course, is that the Colts are entertaining trade offers on Taylor, and if the star RB is ultimately dealt, McGowan and Giddens both figure to take on significantly…

items.h: Seth McGowan a Priority Stash Ahead of Trade Deadline
items.s: Indianapolis Colts running back Seth McGowan should be stashed in most 12+ team fantasy football leagues ahead of the NFL's trade deadline on Nov. 10. There have been plenty of trade rumors circulating around Jonathan Taylor, and if he ends up being dealt, McGowan would take over as Indianapolis' undisputed No. 1 running back. It would take a lot for the Colts to trade Taylor, but it does seem like the rumors have been gaining steam over the last couple of days. Indianapolis has done a good job getting McGowan more involved lately, as he played 34% of the snaps in Week 7 and has totaled 17 touches across his last two games. The 25-year-old rookie from Kentucky would be the Colts' top…

items.h: Seth McGowan gets five carries in Sunday's loss
items.s: Seth McGowan gained 29 yards on five carries in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars. McGowan's name, rightly so, has been increasingly popping up on the fantasy radar as trade rumors have built around Colts star running back Jonathan Taylor. Sunday's game got out of hand by halftime, so the Colts mostly went away from the running game. However, if Taylor is indeed traded away, McGowan could see plenty of work during the second half of the season. The rookie out of Kentucky has averaged 4.4 yards on 37 total carries so far.

items.h: Seth McGowan Still Firmly the Colts' RB2 For Now
items.s: Indianapolis Colts backup running back Seth McGowan hasn't seen more than a handful of touches in any of his games this season, and that's unlikely to change in Week 8. The Colts will take on the Jacksonville Jaguars, and Indianapolis RB1 Jonathan Taylor, who remains with the team for now despite trade rumors swirling, will be the clear workhorse running back as long as he is under contract with them. Taylor is one of the NFL's best running backs, and would be the clear starter on any team that was willing to trade for him or the Colts if they decide to keep him. McGowan saw 11 rushes and one target in Week 7, totaling a season-high 12 touches, but even that was uncharacteristically high…

items.h: Is Seth McGowan a worthwhile add in fantasy football?
Rushes 11 times in loss
items.s: McGowan turned 11 carries into 46 yards, caught his only target for two yards and added 140 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Vikings. McGowan played a season-high 31 percent of the team's offensive snaps, and as a result, he was able to set new highs in both carries and rushing yards. With Jonathan Taylor potentially set to be traded in the coming weeks, the rookie would stand to operate as the team's lead back following Taylor's departure. On the season, McGowan has rushed 34 times for 134 yards and reeled in four of five targets for 12 yards while compiling 566 kickoff-return yards over seven contests so far.

items.h: Seth McGowan a Priority Waiver-Wire Stash Ahead of NFL Trade Deadline
items.s: Indianapolis Colts rookie running back Seth McGowan has played a limited role in his team's offense so far in 2026, recording 146 yards from scrimmage on 36 touches across seven games. The 25-year-old had his usage scaled up in Week 7, logging 11 carries for 46 yards against the Minnesota Vikings. McGowan's growing role could be a sign of things to come. The Colts still have superstar running back Jonathan Taylor firmly ahead of McGowan on the depth chart, which will not change as long as Taylor remains healthy and on the roster. However, with the Colts currently sitting at 2-5 and riding a three-game losing streak, trade speculation around Taylor has begun to heat up. If Taylor were to…

items.h: Seth McGowan sees 11 carries Sunday
items.s: Seth McGowan ran for 46 yards on 11 carries in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings. He also caught his lone target for two yards receiving. McGowan saw a season-high in carries, his first time reaching double-digit carries. He is an intriguing stash for fantasy managers with Jonathan Taylor continuing to have his name brought up in trade rumors.

items.h: Seth McGowan a Top Stash as Teammate's Trade Rumors Heat Up
items.s: Indianapolis Colts running back Seth McGowan is a priority waiver wire target, given that he has the potential to ascend into the No. 1 role over the next few weeks. Trade rumors are heating up surrounding Jonathan Taylor, with several teams expected to have interest if the Colts continue to lose games and trade away some of their top talent. McGowan is the direct backup to Taylor, and he would presumably handle the lead-back role if Taylor were to be traded. While we wouldn't expect McGowan to slot in as a mid-range RB1 in fantasy football, his talent and presumptive volume could at least get him on the RB2 radar, as we don't expect he'd have a ton of competition from DJ Giddens, who has…

items.h: Efficient on low volume Sunday
items.s: McGowan took four carries for 27 yards during Sunday's 26-20 loss versus the Titans. McGowan played exactly 19 offensive snaps for the third straight week Sunday, and although he was slightly less involved than he has been of late in terms of touches, he managed a career-best 6.8 yards per carry in Week 6. He's merely a change-of-pace back as long as three-time Pro Bowler Jonathan Taylor is healthy, but he has the physical traits to become a workhorse should that not be the case at any point this season.

items.h: Seth McGowan a Top Handcuff to Look for on Waivers
items.s: Indianapolis Colts rookie running back Seth McGowan has seen modest involvement in each of the past four games, showing enough to make him an attractive handcuff behind three-time Pro Bowler Jonathan Taylor. With the Colts in free fall at 2-4 and having recently fired longtime general manager Chris Ballard, there is also an outside chance the team could look to move Taylor ahead of the NFL's November 10th trade deadline. A seventh-round pick in the 2026 NFL Draft, McGowan is the only other running back on Indianapolis' roster to receive a carry through six games, averaging more than four yards per attempt, and with multiple paths to an increased workload, he makes for an intriguing…

items.h: Seth McGowan runs for 27 yards in loss
items.s: Seth McGowan ran four times for 27 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday. McGowan is once again playing backup to Jonathan Taylor, which is unlikely to change. Keep him stashed on your bench if you have Taylor.

items.h: Seth McGowan Among the Top Handcuffs to Stash
items.s: Indianapolis Colts running back Seth McGowan has emerged as one of the more appealing handcuff stashes in fantasy football, with a clear path to increased opportunities if Jonathan Taylor misses time. The 6-foot, 223-pound rookie has established himself as Indianapolis' primary backup, while DJ Giddens has yet to play an offensive snap this season. McGowan has recorded 17 carries for 61 yards and three receptions for 10 yards through five games, including five rushes for 16 yards and one catch for three yards in Sunday's loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers. He played 26.1% of the offensive snaps in that contest after reaching a season-high 29% in Week 4. Taylor continues to dominate the…

items.h: Seth McGowan sees six touches in loss
items.s: Seth McGowan ran five times for 16 yards and caught his only target for three yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. McGowan was the clear No.2 back behind Jonathan Taylor yet again, but it didn't amount to much for fantasy. He's a clear-cut handcuff and not a bad one to have, but it's unlikely he will garner enough of a workload to really warrant starting him without a Taylor injury.

items.h: Seth McGowan A Waiver Target As Handcuff RB For Colts
items.s: Indianapolis Colts running back Seth McGowan appears to have fully wrested control of his team's RB2 job away from DJ Giddens, the other RB on the roster aside from starter Jonathan Taylor. Giddens dealt with a knee injury in Week 2, but was a healthy scratch for Week 3, as the coaching staff decided to make Taylor and McGowan the team's active running backs. There is essentially zero chance that McGowan will push the coaching staff to hand him more touches at the expense of Taylor, who's one of the best backs in the league. But the rookie would step into a large role if Taylor got injured, meaning he should be added by fantasy managers who want to handcuff Taylor and in deeper leagues…

items.h: McGowan turned six carries into 31 yards and caught one of two targets for seven yards during Sunday's 30-13 win over the Commanders in London. He also returned four kickoffs for 102 yards.
items.s: McGowan actually saw most of his offensive output in the second quarter with four carries for 18 yards and his seven-yard catch. Most of his on-field production figures to come on special teams as a returner, but the rookie seventh-rounder would be poised for RB1 duties if Jonathan Taylor misses time. The Colts will hit the road for Week 5 against the Steelers this Sunday.

items.h: McGowan rushed twice for zero yards and had two kickoff returns for 58 yards in Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Chiefs.
items.s: McGowan saw just four offensive snaps in the contest, touchding the ball on half of them. The seventh-round rookie did not make a strong impression against the Chiefs' defensive line, but he proved useful on special teams with a 29-yard average on kickoff returns.

items.h: McGowan caught his only target for no gain and notched 164 yards on five kickoff returns during Sunday's 41-23 loss to the Ravens.
items.s: McGowan was only on the field for six of the team's 54 offensive snaps while operating as the top reserve option at running back behind Jonathan Taylor. McGowan definitely made his mark on special teams during the contest, but as long as Taylor is healthy, the former will likely have a limited impact on offense.

items.h: McGowan carried the ball four times for 20 yards and caught his only target for five yards in Saturday's 25-16 preseason loss to the Lions.
items.s: The seventh-round rookie got the start once again, even with DJ Giddens back in the lineup after recovering from a hamstring injury, and McGowan put together the Colts' longest run of the afternoon on a 10-yard scamper in the first quarter to help set up a field goal. Giddens scored the team's only TD of the game in the second quarter, however, as they both make their final cases to be the No. 2 backfield option behind Jonathan Taylor. The two younger backs had similar athleticism-over-production profiles in college, so they could end up trading the job back and forth during the season based…

items.h: McGowan rushed eight times for 27 yards in Saturday's 34-6 preseason loss to the Falcons.
items.s: McGowan started for the second time in as many preseason games, but the rookie seventh-round pick didn't find much running room in the lopsided loss. DJ Giddens is working his way back from a hamstring injury, and the 2025 fifth-round pick represents McGowan's main competition for the backup role behind workhorse Jonathan Taylor. The Colts will wrap up preseason play next Saturday against the Lions.

items.h: Carson Beck, Tre' Harris among deep fantasy football sleepers in 2026
items.s: These sleepers are truly for those in deeper leagues seeking off-the-radar types who could emerge in 2026.

items.h: McGowan carried the ball five times for 17 yards in Thursday's 13-13 preseason tie with the Patriots. He also lost a fumble.
items.s: The rookie seventh-round pick got the start in the Colts' backfield with Jonathan Taylor held out and DJ Giddens (hamstring) sidelined, but McGowan didn't exactly impress in his opportunity. Taylor's the unquestioned RB1 for Indy, if not the centerpiece of the offense, but if he were to suffer an injury, McGowan could find himself handling the bulk of the early-down and goal-line work in the backfield with Giddens having done little to establish himself as a rookie last year.

items.h: McGowan churned out a "handful of big gains" on the ground during the Colts' joint practice session with the Patriots on Tuesday, Joel Erickson of The Indianapolis Star reports.
items.s: Erickson notes that the New England defense stymied both Jonathan Taylor and McGowan throughout the first half of practice, but the Colts' ground game was more effective when the session shifted to the red-zone portion after a special-teams period. McGowan, a seventh-round rookie out of Kentucky, has been serving as the Colts' No. 2 back behind Taylor for most of camp while DJ Giddens has been sidelined by a hamstring injury and has drawn positive reviews for his physical running style. McGowan could still have the early edge for the top backup role even if Giddens is able to get back on the…

items.h: James Boyd of The Athletic suggests that McGowan has emerged as the Colts' top backup running back.
items.s: Per Boyd, with DJ Giddens having been sidelined with a hamstring injury, McGowan has seen added reps of late with the first- and second-team offense. While Jonathan Taylor is the Colts' undisputed top back, and those behind him on the depth chart are off the fantasy lineup radar as long as he's healthy, the pecking order behind him remains of interest in the event that he misses time for any reason. Though Giddens still has a chance to make a push for the RB2 role ahead of Week 1, he'll first need to get back on the practice field to build any momentum toward that end.

items.h: Kevin Bowen of 1075thefan.com notes that he continues to be impressed by what McGowan is showing at running back thus far in training camp.
items.s: At this stage, McGowan, whom the Colts took in the seventh round of the 2026 NFL, is competing with DJ Giddens for slotting behind undisputed top back Jonathan Taylor. While the player who emerges as the team's No. 2 backfield option will hold limited fantasy lineup appeal as long as Taylor is healthy, his backup situation is worth monitoring ahead of Week 1 in the event Taylor misses time this season for any reason.

items.h: The Colts selected McGowan in the seventh round of the 2026 NFL Draft, 237th overall.
items.s: McGowan had a tumultuous college career, which saw him dismissed from Oklahoma's program after being arrested in April of 2021. He didn't see the field again until 2024 with New Mexico State and ended his college career with Kentucky in 2025, when he turned 165 carries into 725 yards and 12 touchdowns along with 19 catches for 126 yards over 11 games. McGowan has good size with a 6-foot, 223-pound frame, and he has the flexibility and strength to move around defenders, though he's not as explosive as other backfield prospects. There will be questions around his character heading into his NFL…
